circuit: 2-qubit Bell (H, CX), measured in XX basis
verdict: No detectable trend even out to fold=81 (range 0.000000, noise floor ~0.003000 at 1000000 shots). Gate folding does not appear to be a usable ZNE knob against IonQ's aria-1 simulated noise profile -- consistent with aria-1 being a fixed noise profile rather than a per-gate depolarizing model that responds to stretched circuit depth.
